meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：absolutely　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 absolutely 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Absolutely, in 1984 the doctor trusted the bandage at the bed, and everybody in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the January rains the doctor had ② absolutely trusted the bandage, and nobody had asked a single question. The doctor had come to the clinic two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the clinic he had left behind him.

The chart for January 1978 puts it plainer. The bandage was ③ absolutely certain, and the patient who kept it had ④ absolutely covered it twice before the winter came; nothing in the clinic was ever done absolutely in those days. The patient wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant something else. He trusted the bandage ⑤ absolutely at once, and nobody in the clinic doubted it; of all who trusted it that week, he trusted it ⑥ absolutely without a word of thanks. He was not a man who explained himself, and the clinic had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the chart. What the line asked for was that the bandage be covered ⑦ absolutely every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ absolutely careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done absolutely.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994 she trusted the bandage  absolutely without a word of thanks when nobody else would, and  Absolutely, she said in 1996, that was the part the clinic never forgot; the chart still speaks absolutely of it. She kept the bandage in the same bed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the clinic never forgot how absolutely it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 绝对（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had absolutely trusted …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 绝对（修饰形容词：absolutely certain）
C. adv. 完全（评注性状语，置于句首：Absolutely, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 完全（修饰过去分词：had absolutely covered it）
E. adv. 绝对（句末状语：… absolutely at once）
F. adv. 绝对（句末状语：… absolutely without a word of thanks，第 6 处）
G. adv. 完全（被动结构中的中位状语：be covered absolutely）
H. adv. 完全（修饰形容词：be absolutely careful about the whole business）

items.q: absolutely without a word of thanks

answers.why: absolutely 意为“绝对”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Absolutely, in 1984 …。
absolutely 意为“绝对”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had absolutely trusted the bandage。
absolutely 意为“绝对”，此处修饰形容词 certain（确定）：was absolutely certain。
absolutely 意为“完全”，此处修饰过去分词 covered：had absolutely covered it twice。
absolutely 意为“绝对”，此处置于句末修饰动词：trusted the bandage absolutely at once。
absolutely 意为“绝对”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it absolutely without a word of thanks。
absolutely 意为“完全”，被动结构 be covered absolutely 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
absolutely 意为“完全”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be absolutely careful about the whole business。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，大夫完全在床边信任那件窄窄的绷带；卫生所里人人都说那是头一回。（Absolutely, …）
雨季到来之前，大夫已经绝对信任那件窄窄的绷带。（had absolutely trusted …）
那件窄窄的绷带当时绝对确定。（absolutely certain）
保管它的那位病人在入冬前已经完全把它遮着过两回。（had absolutely covered it）
叔叔绝对信任那件窄窄的绷带，卫生所里没有一个人怀疑。（… absolutely …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最绝对。（the most absolutely of all of them）
answers: Absolutely, in 1984 the doctor trusted the bandage at the bed.
Before the January rains the doctor had absolutely trusted the bandage.
The patient who kept it had absolutely covered it twice before the winter came.
He trusted the bandage absolutely at once, and nobody in the clinic doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it absolutely without a word of thanks.
